resolved_findings.resolution: Added config_identity_kind and bound current F00 CONFIG/HYBRID baseline to the immutable 258-parameter experiment-config snapshot; distinguished it from the PPL epoch-birth config hash.
Defined canonical hypothesis/evaluation subdocuments and identical-vs-conflicting duplicate candidate creation behavior.
Introduced EXACT_DATASET versus FUTURE_DATASET_REQUIREMENT so prospective validation can be frozen without inventing a future dataset_id.
Separated DISCOVERY/EVALUATION/VALIDATION roles and prohibited silent qualification on the same F00 evidence that generated the hypothesis.
Defined deterministic evaluation_run_id and explicit comparability rules for metric deltas.
Defined proposal-only NOT_IMPLEMENTED strategy candidates as immutable and required a successor candidate with lineage when implementation identity later exists.
Defined canonical CODE_PATCH digest from pinned Git objects and sorted changed paths.
Defined exact legal transitions, illegal skips, terminal states and RESEARCH_ONLY non-promotable behavior.
Separated global registry_sequence from per-candidate candidate_transition_ordinal and made event_id fully deterministic.
Defined deterministic promotion_request_id, request states and the boundary that only a separate owner/promotion mission may authorize/execute promotion.
Frozen normative candidate/evaluation/event/promotion schema identifiers; unknown schemas fail closed.
Added canonical lineage arrays participating in candidate identity and removed ambiguous singular successor terminology.
